name: Ina
source:
Year: 2nd year
Affiliation: Assistance robot of the W.L.O.
Likes: Omurice (omelet rice), egg dishes, glasses
Blood type: Alkaline type

An assistance robot made by W.L.O. who is sent to [url=/c34897]Yuuki[/url] in order to help him. Her codename in W.L.O. is "Lilly". She looks more like a human than a robot, but acts like she has been just born: she is curious about everything, and also naturally clumsy. Her memory is so bad that Ina can't remember neither her official name nor model number. Ina idolizes [url=/c7209]Hotaru[/url] so much that she keeps glasses on her head, even though they don't actually fit her at all.
